resources.string: Share which screens and features you use and when something fails, so problems get fixed sooner. Anonymous, with no name or email.
Also share my records (food, weight, sleep, steps, the start of my messages to Coach)

Food with its macros, weight, water, a daily summary (sleep, steps, training) and the first 300 characters of each message to Coach. Only the developer can see them; turning this off deletes what was waiting.

Sends anonymous usage and errors (screens, features, failed AI calls, crashes) with the app version and phone model. Your records go only if you also turn on "Include my records". Turning it off deletes what was waiting to be sent.
